sources.title: CSL Super Fuzz | Effects Database
sources.excerpt: Effects Database has an exact CSL Super Fuzz record and classifies the named model as a fuzz pedal. The exact page identifies CSL Super Fuzz within the historical CSL catalog and distinguishes it from the many related Tone Bender-style and later reissue models listed elsewhere in the database.

sources.title: CSL Super Fuzz | guitar moderne
sources.excerpt: Guitar Moderne identifies a vintage CSL Super Fuzz in its documentation of Ed O'Brien's pedalboard. The article explicitly names CSL Super Fuzz and identifies it among the other pedals in the rig, providing an independent second source for the exact model identity.
